Through: Mr. Manoj Pant, App f
 with Si Ramkesh Meena
 Connaught Place.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

The instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("Cr.P.C") has been filed by petitioners seeking following prayer:
"(i) Pass necessary orders and directions, thereby quashing the FIR bearing no. 256 dated 21.12.2022 U/S 406, 409, 420, 465, 468 & 471 of IPC registered at P.S.
Connaught Place qua the Petitioners named in the FIR along with all the proceedings emanating therefrom;
(ii) Pass necessary orders and directions, thereby setting aside/quashing/ cancelling the impugned order dated 19.12.2022 passed by Ld. M.M 01, New Delhi District,
Patiala House Court in CC No. 2168/2022 qua the Petitioners named in the FIR along with all the proceedings emanating therefrom;"
4.
Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State and seeks time to file Status Report.
Let the same be filed at least three days prior to the next date of hearing.
